cards.example_en: My grandfather still adds numbers quickly on a wooden abacus.
cards.example_zh: 我爷爷仍用一把木算盘快速做加法。

cards.example_en: They went aboard the school bus.
cards.example_zh: 他们上了校车。

cards.example_en: Plants absorb carbon dioxide from the air.
cards.example_zh: 植物吸收空气中的二氧化碳。

cards.example_en: My sister trains every evening at the music academy.
cards.example_zh: 我姐姐每天晚上都在音乐学院训练。

cards.example_en: I accidentally sent the message to the wrong classmate.
cards.example_zh: 我不小心把消息发给了别的同学。

cards.example_en: My aunt works as an accountant in a small office.
cards.example_zh: 我姑姑在一间小办公室里做会计。

cards.example_en: The report gives an accurate picture of the problem.
cards.example_zh: 该报告准确地描述了问题。

cards.example_en: We circled every adjective on the weather worksheet.
cards.example_zh: 我们在天气练习纸上圈出了每一个形容词。

cards.example_en: We watched in admiration as she finished the marathon.
cards.example_zh: 她跑完马拉松时，我们都钦佩地看着。

cards.example_en: The school will adopt a new timetable next term.
cards.example_zh: 学校下学期将采用一份新的时间表。

cards.example_en: Travelling alone was a real adventure.
cards.example_zh: 独自旅行是一次真正的冒险。

cards.example_en: I saw an advertisement for a new phone.
cards.example_zh: 我看到一个新手机的广告。

cards.example_en: Shops advertise summer clothes in the window this week.
cards.example_zh: 各家商店本周在橱窗里为夏装做广告。

cards.example_en: The advertiser paid the school team to wear those new shirts.
cards.example_zh: 广告商付钱让校队穿上那些新球衣。

cards.example_en: Advertising on the school website brought more visitors.
cards.example_zh: 学校网站上登的广告带来了更多访问者。

cards.example_en: Our aeroplane landed in Guangzhou just before the heavy rain.
cards.example_zh: 大雨来临前，我们的飞机降落在广州。

cards.example_en: The missing wallet became a family affair that evening.
cards.example_zh: 那天晚上，钱包丢了成了全家人的事。

cards.example_en: We played basketball and went for noodles afterwards.
cards.example_zh: 我们打完篮球，后来去吃了面条。

cards.example_en: The travel agency booked our train tickets yesterday.
cards.example_zh: 旅行社昨天把我们的火车票订好了。

cards.example_en: Sports day is the first item on the school agenda.
cards.example_zh: 运动会是学校议程上的第一项。

cards.example_en: We visited an agricultural show and saw cows that won prizes.
cards.example_zh: 我们参观了农业展览，看到了获奖的牛。

cards.example_en: Our village depends on agriculture and the summer rain.
cards.example_zh: 我们村靠农业和夏天的雨水过日子。

cards.example_en: Which airline are we taking for the family holiday?
cards.example_zh: 这次全家出去度假，我们坐哪家航空公司？

cards.example_en: The nurse cleaned my cut with alcohol at the clinic.
cards.example_zh: 护士在诊所里用酒精给我洗了伤口。

cards.example_en: Alcoholic drinks were banned at the school leavers' party.
cards.example_zh: 学校毕业生聚会上禁止含酒精的饮料。

cards.example_en: The alphabet song helped my little brother learn letters.
cards.example_zh: 字母歌帮我弟弟学会了字母。

cards.example_en: Please put the library cards in alphabetical order before lunch.
cards.example_zh: 午饭前请把图书卡按字母顺序排好。

cards.example_en: The class list is arranged alphabetically by family name.
cards.example_zh: 班级名单按姓氏字母顺序排列。

cards.example_en: Street magicians amaze tourists near the shopping mall every weekend.
cards.example_zh: 每个周末，街头魔术师都在商场附近让游客大吃一惊。

cards.example_en: Her ambition is to become a doctor after university.
cards.example_zh: 她的抱负是大学毕业以后当医生。

cards.example_en: The ambitious student aims for the top score in physics.
cards.example_zh: 那个有野心的学生想拿下物理最高分。

cards.example_en: A large amount of money was stolen.
cards.example_zh: 一大笔钱被偷了。

cards.example_en: The clown's tricks amuse the children.
cards.example_zh: 小丑的把戏把孩子们逗乐了。

cards.example_en: Grandpa told an amusing joke while we washed the dishes.
cards.example_zh: 我们洗碗时，爷爷讲了一个有趣的笑话。

cards.example_en: Draw this angle carefully on your geometry paper.
cards.example_zh: 在几何纸上把这个角仔细画出来。

cards.example_en: I twisted my ankle on the stairs at home yesterday.
cards.example_zh: 昨天我在家里的楼梯上把脚踝扭伤了。

cards.example_en: The announcement said the pool would close early.
cards.example_zh: 公告上说，游泳池会提前关闭。

cards.example_en: Our annual school fair raises money for new library books.
cards.example_zh: 我们一年一度的学校义卖为图书馆的新书筹款。

cards.example_en: I do not take the late bus anymore because it is too slow.
cards.example_zh: 我不再坐那班晚班车了，因为它太慢。

cards.example_en: You should apologise to her for spilling the juice.
cards.example_zh: 你应该为洒了果汁向她道歉。

cards.example_en: He offered an apology for breaking his sister's cup.
cards.example_zh: 他因为打碎了姐姐的杯子而道了歉。

cards.example_en: Loud applause filled the hall after the choir sang.
cards.example_zh: 合唱团唱完以后，大厅里响起了热烈的掌声。

cards.example_en: Every applicant must fill in this form.
cards.example_zh: 每位申请人都必须填这张表。

cards.example_en: I sent my application to the summer science camp.
cards.example_zh: 我把申请书寄给了暑期科学营。

cards.example_en: I've got a doctor's appointment at three.
cards.example_zh: 我三点要去看医生。

cards.example_en: I really appreciate your help with my science project.
cards.example_zh: 我非常感激你帮我做科学项目。

cards.example_en: Arctic animals appear on the posters in our science corner.
cards.example_zh: 我们科学角的海报上有北极动物。

cards.example_en: Grandpa fell asleep in the armchair after lunch.
cards.example_zh: 午饭后，爷爷在扶手椅上睡着了。

cards.example_en: The arrest of the thief was on the evening news.
cards.example_zh: 那个小偷被逮捕的消息上了晚间新闻。

cards.example_en: His arrow hit the centre of the target in PE.
cards.example_zh: 体育课上，他射出的箭正中靶心。
